description:
Typecast API client for text-to-speech and voice management. `TypecastClient` extends `Lyo.Api.Client.ApiClient`, configures the `X-API-KEY` header from `TypecastClientOptions`, and exposes two managers (`TextToSpeech`, `Voices`) for the underlying REST endpoints.

Multi-targets `netstandard2.0` and `net10.0`.

examples.title: Register services
`TypecastClient`
examples.code:
public readonly TextToSpeechManager TextToSpeech;
public readonly VoiceManager Voices;

sections.title: Registration
sections.text: Three DI extensions are available on `IServiceCollection`: All variants register `TypecastClient` as a singleton. `ILoggerFactory` and `HttpClient` are pulled from the container if available; otherwise sensible defaults are used. Example `appsettings.json`:

sections.title: `TypecastClientOptions`
rows: `"TypecastClient"`. Used by `AddTypecastClientFromConfiguration` as the default section.
sections.lead: Extends `ApiClientOptions`, so it inherits the standard HTTP transport knobs (`BaseUrl`, timeouts, retry, etc.).
sections.trail: JSON is serialized with snake_case naming, case-insensitive read, and `WhenWritingNull` ignore, matching Typecast's API.

sections.title: Request models
items: **`TypecastTtsRequest`.** Extends `Lyo.Tts.Models.TtsRequest`. Fields: `VoiceId`, `Text`, `Model` (defaults to `TypecastModel.SsfmV30`), `Language` (`LanguageCodeInfo`, serialized as ISO 639-3), `Prompt`, `Output`, `Seed`, computed `AudioFormat`.
**`Prompt`.** emotion / style settings (including the `"smart"` mode with optional `previous_text` / `next_text` context).

sections.title: `TypecastTtsRequestBuilder`
rows: Parses ISO 639-3 first then ISO 639-1; falls back to no language when unknown.
Validates required fields and returns the `TypecastTtsRequest`.
